title: Add File Upload
content: Create file upload component with drag-and-drop zone. Drop zone: border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-8 text-center. Drag active state: border-blue-500 bg-blue-50. Content: Upload icon, "Drag files here or click to browse" text, accepted file types info. Hidden file input triggered by click. Preview uploaded files: list with filename, size, remove button. Progress bar for upload status. Validation: file type, max size, max files. Error states with red border and message. Support single or multiple file selection.

variants.simple: Create a file upload component with drag and drop support.
variants.detailed: Create file upload component with drag-and-drop zone. Drop zone: border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-8 text-center. Drag active state: border-blue-500 bg-blue-50. Content: Upload icon, "Drag files here or click to browse" text, accepted file types info. Hidden file input triggered by click. Preview uploaded files: list with filename, size, remove button. Progress bar for upload status. Validation: file type, max size, max files. Error states with red border and message. Support single or multiple file selection.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive file upload component with drag-and-drop and previews. Drop zone container: relative border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-8 transition-colors. States: default (border-gray-300 bg-gray-50), drag-over (border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 scale-[1.02]), drag-reject (border-red-500 bg-red-50), disabled (opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed). Center content: flex flex-col items-center gap-4 - Upload cloud icon (w-12 h-12 text-gray-400), primary text "Drag and drop files here", secondary text "or click to browse", accepted formats text (text-xs text-gray-500). Hidden input: type="file" with accept, multiple attributes, sr-only positioning. File previews: grid or list below drop zone. Image files: thumbnail preview with object-cover. Other files: icon based on type (FileText, FileSpreadsheet, etc). Preview item: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg - thumbnail/icon, filename (truncate), file size, remove X button, upload progress bar. Progress: h-1 absolute bottom-0 bg-blue-600 transition-all. Validation: accept prop for file types, maxSize (show error for too large), maxFiles (disable when reached). Error display: red border, error message below. Upload states per file: pending, uploading (with progress %), complete (checkmark), error (retry button). Accessibility: proper labels, keyboard accessible, focus states. Props: accept, maxSize, maxFiles, onFilesSelected, onFileRemove, uploading, progress, disabled. Drag events: onDragEnter, onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop with file validation.
